# Which workstation has which container of distrobox.nix: NAME HOST=STATE...
# all=STATE (lib/ws_marks.py). HOST is `ws host`; STATE yes (created there),
# no (declined), ask (not offered; wsbox apply asks). all= counts only for a
# workstation without its own mark. wsbox create/apply/remove edit this file,
# ws switch commits it; a container without a line is offered (ask).
arch mbp16=yes all=ask
wine-wayland mbp16=yes all=ask
wine mbp16=yes all=ask
proton mbp16=yes all=ask
# T2 builds (t2bce, Touch Bar): only mbp16.
t2bce-build mbp16=yes all=no
touchbar-build mbp16=yes all=no
